title: Focus beyond Quadratic Speedups for Error-Corrected Quantum Advantage
authors: Ryan Babbush; Jarrod R. McClean; Michael Newman; Craig Gidney; Sergio Boixo; Hartmut Neven
supports: PRX Quantum 2, 010103 (2021). Under a surface-code model with about 170 µs per Toffoli, quadratic speedups do not give advantage on early fault-tolerant devices (decision-path callout for Grover).

title: How to factor 2048 bit RSA integers in 8 hours using 20 million noisy qubits
supports: Quantum 5, 433 (2021). RSA-2048 estimate of 20 million noisy qubits and 8 hours, assuming 0.1% gate error, 1 µs surface-code cycle and 10 µs reaction time (decision-path callout for order finding).

title: How to factor 2048 bit RSA integers with less than a million noisy qubits
supports: arXiv preprint (May 2025), not peer reviewed as of the check date. Fewer than a million noisy qubits and under a week, under the same hardware assumptions as the 2021 estimate (decision-path callout for Shor).

title: Even more efficient quantum computations of chemistry through tensor hypercontraction
authors: Joonho Lee; Dominic W. Berry; Craig Gidney; William J. Huggins; Jarrod R. McClean; Nathan Wiebe; Ryan Babbush
supports: PRX Quantum 2, 030305 (2021). For the Reiher FeMoco model, about 4 million physical qubits and roughly 3.5 days, assuming a 1 µs cycle and 0.1% physical error (decision-path callout for energy estimation).
note: The paper reports 5.3×10^9 Toffolis in Table III and 6.7×10^9 in its surface-code compilation text.
